This page presents the learned representations from the ALIGATEHR-Gen model and its quantitative performance against baselines. Explore the ICD code embedding space, and compare evaluation metrics across diseases. The patient embeddings live on the [Use Case](use-case.qmd#patient-embedding) page.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

createScatterplot = (await import("https://esm.sh/regl-scatterplot@1.9.1")).default
```

## ICD-10 Code Embedding UMAP {#icd-embedding}

Use the chatbot to request a reviewed ICD Keyword Match, or search the tracked code nodes directly below. Keyword actions are navigation-only and remain separate from Demo Profile comparison.

Hover a point for its code and title. Click one to open its ICD-10 category and browse the codes underneath it, or pick a chapter from the legend to focus the view on that chapter.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

import { createIcdKeywordScatter } from "./icd-keyword-scatter.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

icdData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/icd_code_embeddings.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Code titles and the ICD hierarchy behind the hover panel. Parsed without
// autoType so every column stays a string.
icdReference = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/icd_code_reference.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof icdSearch = Inputs.text({ label: "Search ICD code or description", placeholder: "e.g. E11, diabetes, circulatory..." })
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

icdUmap = {
  const query = icdSearch.toLowerCase().trim();
  const schemeCategory20 = [
    "#1f77b4","#ff7f0e","#2ca02c","#d62728","#9467bd",
    "#8c564b","#e377c2","#7f7f7f","#bcbd22","#17becf",
    "#aec7e8","#ffbb78","#98df8a","#ff9896","#c5b0d5",
    "#c49c94","#f7b6d2","#c7c7c7","#dbdb8d","#9edae5"
  ];
  let removeRequestListener = () => {};
  let chart = null;
  invalidation.then(() => {
    removeRequestListener();
    if (chart) chart.icdKeywordWalkthrough.destroy();
  });

  let helper = window.ALIGATEHR_ICD_KEYWORD;
  for (let attempt = 0; !helper && attempt < 20; attempt += 1) {
    await new Promise(resolve => window.setTimeout(resolve, 50));
    helper = window.ALIGATEHR_ICD_KEYWORD;
  }
  if (!helper) throw new Error("The ICD visualization request helper is unavailable.");

  const consumed = helper.consumeRequest(sessionStorage);
  chart = await createIcdKeywordScatter({
    data: icdData,
    reference: icdReference,
    createScatterplot,
    colors: schemeCategory20,
    searchQuery: query,
    request: consumed.request,
    autoplay: consumed.should_play,
  });
  removeRequestListener = helper.connectRequestConsumer(
    window,
    sessionStorage,
    request => chart.icdKeywordWalkthrough.focus(request),
  );
  window.__ALIGATEHR_ICD_READY__ = true;
  return chart;
}
```

## Evaluation Metrics Comparison

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

import { bindHighlightGroups, bindSingleMarkTooltip, createChartTooltip } from "./chart-highlighting.js"
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

evalData = {
  const text = await FileAttachment("data/evaluation_metrics.csv").text();
  return d3.csvParse(text, d3.autoType);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// Chart Preset (ADR-0016): shareable ?metric=... URL state.
metricPreset = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get("metric")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof selectedMetric = Inputs.select(
  [...new Set(evalData.map(d => d.metric))],
  {
    label: "Metric",
    value: [...new Set(evalData.map(d => d.metric))].includes(metricPreset)
      ? metricPreset
      : "AUROC"
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

evalChart = {
  const filtered = evalData.filter(d => d.metric === selectedMetric);
  const diseases = [...new Set(filtered.map(d => d.disease))];
  const models = [...new Set(filtered.map(d => d.model))];

  // Sort diseases by proposed model performance (descending)
  const proposed = filtered.filter(d => d.is_proposed);
  diseases.sort((a, b) => {
    const va = proposed.find(d => d.disease === a)?.value || 0;
    const vb = proposed.find(d => d.disease === b)?.value || 0;
    return vb - va;
  });

  const proposedModel = "ALIGATEHR-Gen";
  const grayScale = ["#888","#aaa","#666","#999","#bbb","#777","#ccc","#555","#ddd"];
  const modelColors = {};
  let gi = 0;
  for (const m of models) {
    modelColors[m] = m === proposedModel ? "#2c5aa0" : grayScale[gi++ % grayScale.length];
  }

  const dotMarks = models.map((model) =>
    Plot.dot(filtered.filter(d => d.model === model), {
      x: "value",
      y: "disease",
      fill: modelColors[model],
      r: model === proposedModel ? 6 : 4,
      symbol: model === proposedModel ? "circle" : "diamond2",
    })
  );

  const chart = Plot.plot({
    width: 1000,
    height: 420,
    marginLeft: 180,
    marginRight: 20,
    x: { label: selectedMetric, grid: true },
    y: { label: null, domain: diseases },
    marks: dotMarks,
  });

  // Wrap with title
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  const titleDiv = document.createElement("div");
  titleDiv.innerHTML = `<strong style="font-size:1.1rem;color:#2c3e50;">Model Performance Comparison</strong><br><span style="font-size:0.9rem;color:#6c757d;">${models.length} models × ${diseases.length} diseases · Metric: ${selectedMetric}</span>`;
  titleDiv.style.marginBottom = "8px";
  container.appendChild(titleDiv);
  container.appendChild(chart);

  const tooltip = createChartTooltip(container);

  const dotGroups = [...chart.querySelectorAll('g[aria-label="dot"]')];
  if (dotGroups.length !== models.length) {
    throw new Error("Model performance mark groups do not match the model data");
  }
  const tooltipPoints = [];
  const tooltipRows = [];
  models.forEach((model, index) => {
    const rows = filtered.filter(d => d.model === model);
    const points = [...dotGroups[index].querySelectorAll("circle, path")];
    if (points.length !== rows.length) {
      throw new Error(`Model performance points do not match ${model}`);
    }
    tooltipPoints.push(...points);
    tooltipRows.push(...rows);
  });
  bindSingleMarkTooltip(tooltipPoints, tooltip, index => {
    const d = tooltipRows[index];
    const interval = d.ci_lower != null
      ? `<br>CI: [${d.ci_lower.toFixed(4)}, ${d.ci_upper.toFixed(4)}]`
      : "";
    return `<strong>${d.model}</strong><br>${d.disease}<br>${selectedMetric}: ${d.value.toFixed(4)}${interval}`;
  });

  // Custom legend
  const legendDiv = document.createElement("div");
  legendDiv.className = "chart-highlight-legend";
  container.appendChild(legendDiv);

  const legendButtons = new Map();
  models.forEach((model) => {
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.className = "chart-highlight-action";
    button.classList.toggle("is-proposed", model === proposedModel);
    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", "false");
    const marker = document.createElement("span");
    marker.className = "chart-highlight-marker";
    marker.style.color = modelColors[model];
    marker.textContent = model === proposedModel ? "●" : "◆";
    button.append(marker, document.createTextNode(model));
    legendDiv.appendChild(button);
    legendButtons.set(model, button);
  });

  const seriesNodes = new Map(models.map((model, index) => [
    model,
    [dotGroups[index]],
  ]));
  bindHighlightGroups({
    groupKeys: models,
    targetsByGroup: seriesNodes,
    actionsByGroup: legendButtons,
    labelForGroup: model => `Highlight ${model}`,
  });

  return container;
}
```
